subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: Should OpenClaw expose same-turn transcript/tool-call/result evidence to outbound pre-send plugin hooks, and what bounded, permissioned Plugin SDK shape should own it?
rationale: The remaining work changes public plugin API semantics and can expose sensitive session/tool data before delivery, so automation cannot safely choose field shape, redaction, permissions, or hook ownership.

options.title: Add bounded evidence contract
options.body: Expose run identity plus capped, redacted same-turn verification evidence on the chosen pre-send hook and document the permission/security model.

options.title: Land identity only first
options.body: Add outbound runId/message identity now while leaving deterministic evidence for a later Plugin SDK design.

options.title: Treat existing hooks as sufficient
options.body: Close the request as covered by `reply_payload_sending` and sessionKey correlation, accepting that plugins still lack first-class tool/result evidence.

recommendation.title: Add bounded evidence contract
recommendation.body: Expose run identity plus capped, redacted same-turn verification evidence on the chosen pre-send hook and document the permission/security model.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review already framed this as a product/security decision and this owner is closest to the current issue decision boundary.
